name: Biting Performance
body:
Your performances cause glittering, sharp gnashing teeth to appear on your allies’ weapons, causing them to bite your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): 1st-level bard

Benefit: Whenever you use your bardic performance, all weapons that your allies are wielding begin to glow red. On the tips of the weapons appears a large, grinning mouth filled with rows of sharp, glimmering teeth. Whenever an ally hits an enemy with his weapon, the mouth bites the opponent hit with the weapon for 1d6 extra damage.
